correctness.rationale: Conditional attachment indicators yield the mixed moment relation including the root-leaf event. First moment recurrences have explicit central-binomial solutions. Exact increments establish all-size signs, telescoping gives the sum, summability proves square-root covariance asymptotic. Factorial root-degree moments and leaf-variance recursion prove the correlation constant. Independent exact probability enumeration through nine vertices, 88 recurrence cases and large-n checks passed 132 assertions.

value.rationale: The oldest hub has square-root degree while leaves are a linear-scale global population. A new exact positive covariance with divergent square-root magnitude and vanishing inverse-square-root correlation identifies a structural dependence scale invisible to either marginal; its contrast with the bounded uniform-recursive-tree covariance is quantitatively meaningful.
